about.title: I build Android system tools by configuring the system to optimize performance

desc.me: I am an 11th-grade Software Engineering student working on projects ranging from front-end web development with React and Next.js to Android-side experiments — including modifying the root environment with KernelSU and developing native applications using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose.
desc.work: I have learned many programming languages, but the ones I use most frequently are Bash and JavaScript. I use these two languages to create Android App Manager plugins like KernelSU (ROOT Manager) and AxManager (No Root Manager). By utilizing a web app-based interface, I can integrate Bash scripts through the built-in APIs of KernelSU, which are also used in AxManager. This allows users to easily and quickly perform advanced Android system configurations. Other programming languages I have learned include Java, Kotlin, TypeScript, and Python, alongside frameworks such as React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Vite, and Jetpack Compose.
